14.DRUG INTERACTIONS WITH HORMONAL CONTRACEPTION:

Enzyme inducers which may DECREASE contraceptive efficacy

Antiepileptics
(e.g. carbamazepine, eslicarbazepine, fosphenytoin, oxcarbazepine, phenobarbital, phenytoin, primidone, rufinamide, topiramate)

Antibacterials
(e.g. rifabutin, rifampicin)

Antiretrovirals
(e.g. efavirenz, nevirapine)
Note: Ritonavir reduces the bioavailability of estrogen and may reduce the bioavailability of progestogens by inducing glucuronidation.

Antidepressants
(e.g. St John’s wort – a herbal preparation)

Others
(e.g. modafinil, bosentan, aprepitant, lumacaftor)

Enzyme inhibiting drugs that may INCREASE hormone levels:

•Antibacterials (e.g. erythromycin)
• Antifungals (e.g. fluconazole, itraconazole, ketoconazole, posaconazole, voriconazole)
• Antiretrovirals (e.g. atazanavir)
•Immunosuppressants (e.g. tacrolimus)
•Non-steroidal anti-inflammatories (NSAIDs) (e.g. etoricoxib)
•Statins (e.g. atorvastatin, rosuvastatin)
•Vasodilators (e.g. sitaxentan sodium)

 

 

Note:

Lamotrigine (antiepileptic) and griseofulvin (antifungal) are not thought to be enzyme-inducing drugs; however, contraceptive efficacy may still be reduced by concurrent use.
The clinical significance of this effect is unknown

Effects of contraceptive hormones on other drugs

⇨Antiepileptics
•Combined hormonal contraception (CHC) moderately reduces lamotrigine exposure.
•This can lead to decreased seizure control during the hormone phase and increased lamotrigine exposure and toxicity risk in the hormone-free week.
⇨Desogestrel
•Might increase lamotrigine levels and adverse effects.
•Ethinylestradiol (EE) may modestly reduce sodium valproate levels.
⇨Progestogen receptor modulators

Quick starting hormonal contraception after ulipristal acetate (UPA) for emergency contraception (EC) may reduce EC effectiveness.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

Possible adverse effects and/or consider some monitoring

Drug Class

Interaction

Antihypertensives

Estrogens may increase BP and antagonize antihypertensive efficacy.

Antidiabetics

Estrogens may antagonize the hypoglycemic effect of antidiabetics.

Anxiolytics & hypnotics

Estrogens and progestogens may reduce plasma concentrations of lorazepam, oxazepam, and temazepam.

Thyroid hormones

Estrogens may increase the requirements for thyroid hormones in hypothyroidism.

 

Increased levels or adverse effects

Drug Class

Interaction Details

✅ Immunosuppressants

EE (Ethinylestradiol) might increase tacrolimus concentrations — should be monitored by a specialist. Ciclosporin levels may be increased by estrogens and progestogens.

✅ UPA (Ulipristal Acetate)

Predicted to increase everolimus and sirolimus concentrations.

✅ Dopaminergic

Selegiline levels may increase due to estrogens/progestogens → toxicity risk. EE reduces ropinirole clearance by ~one-third. Manufacturers advise avoiding concurrent use.

 

Possible adverse effects and/or consider some monitoring

Drug Class

Interaction

Antifungals

Estrogens and progestogens may increase levels of voriconazole.

Anxiolytics & hypnotics

Estrogens and progestogens may increase plasma concentrations of chlordiazepoxide, diazepam, and clorazepate.

Bronchodilators

Estrogens slightly reduce the clearance of theophylline, leading to increased plasma concentrations. Reducing dosage is recommended if adverse effects occur.

Muscle relaxants

Estrogens and progestogens may increase tizanidine levels and its adverse effects.

Possible adverse effects and/or consider some monitoring

Drug Class

Interaction

✅ Potassium-sparing diuretics and aldosterone antagonists

Additive hyperkaliemia or hypotension might occur with Drosperinone and potassium-sparing diuretics.

✅ Retinoids

Adverse effects of oral contraceptives on lipids may add to those of isotretinoin. As retinoids are teratogenic, highly effective contraception (e.g., IUDs or progestogen-only implants) is recommended.

✅ Triptans

COCs (Combined Oral Contraceptives) appear to slightly raise levels of frovatriptan, naratriptan, and zolmitriptan, though not clinically significant.
